TMEDA crosslinker (Fig. 4: bis-quaternary bridge between CH2 groups of two chains) added at 0.1 mL per 10 g of 15% w/v CMPSF/DMAc casting solution; additive_c2=0.05 is an ESTIMATE of TMEDA/CMPSF weight ratio (0.1 mL x 0.775 g/mL = 78 mg per ~1.5 g CMPSF; TMEDA density and solution density ~1 g/mL are outside assumptions; ~0.23 mol TMEDA per repeat unit). Surface modifier not encoded as SMILES (inorganic filler).
notes: QPSF (Udel P3500 PSF) chloromethylated with CME/SnCl4 at 30 C, 40 min (optimum conditions = Table 1 entry 8, DCM 138% by 1H NMR; consistent with Fig. 2 integrals f/2 / b/4 = 0.345/0.25), CH2Cl ortho to the ether O of the bisphenol-A rings (Fig. 1/2/4), then fully quaternized with trimethylamine (assumed complete) and OH- exchanged. DS 1.38 per repeat unit modelled as 62% mono- + 38% di-benzyltrimethylammonium repeat units (c1=0.62, c2=0.38). Calculated IEC 2.44 mmol/g matches the paper's 'in excess of 2.40 mmol/g'.

curation_notes: PPO-b-PVBTMA diblock (solvent cast + melt pressed 5 min at 240 C/30 MPa), quaternized with TMA. PPO:PVBC = ca. 30:70 (paper; basis unspecified, treated as mole fraction). PVB block split into quaternized VBTMA (c2) and thermally dehydrochlorinated/crosslinked VB units (c3) from titrated IEC 2.2 mmol/g (Table 1): IEC=1000*c2/(0.3*120.15+211.7*c2+117.2*(0.7-c2)) (Cl- form masses) -> c2=0.328, c3=0.372. Crosslinks formed in situ by HCl elimination during melt pressing (C=C formation suggested; Friedel-Crafts not excluded); the crosslinked unit is represented as a dechlorinated 4-methylstyrene-type unit because the inter-chain bond cannot be drawn with two attachment points. Para substitution of VBC assumed (not stated). Elemental-analysis IEC (2.2-2.4) differs from titration; titration used.
